name: flutter-merge-into-host
description: Merges another standalone Flutter project's UI (lib/ + assets/ + pubspec deps) into the current host Flutter project as a self-contained feature subtree. 5-phase pipeline (discover / decide / graft / adapt / verify) with 9 adapt rules covering screenutil suffixes, DebounceUtil wrapping, ToastUtil replacement, host theme integration, go_router compat, category-list PageView linkage, splash widget injection, widget file split, and base button label overflow guard.
